Lead Test Development: Complete hands-on ownership of product quality and test automation, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Drive Project Test Strategy: Own and define the end-to-end test strategy for major projects and releases. Collaborate with development, product, and other stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage that mitigates risk. Automation Test Development: Take a leading role in the design, architecture, design, development and maintenance of our test automation frameworks. Make key technical decisions to improve efficiency, scalability, and ease of use. Champion Advanced Testing Practices: Lead the execution of complex testing scenarios, including performance, scalability, and security testing. Ensure that the team is equipped and trained to identify critical, system-level issues. Global Quality Alignment: Interface with QA leads across the globe to ensure project strategies are aligned with broader organizational quality goals and standards. Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance and test automation, with at least 1-2 years in a formal or informal leadership/mentorship capacity. Test Automation: Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks for both mobile (e.g., Appium, Espresso) and web/API (e.g., Selenium, Postman, REST Assured) applications. Platform Expertise: Proven ability to test complex, enterprise level Android and cloud-based applications, demonstrating a deep understanding of their architectures. Advanced Testing: Hands-on experience in understanding workflows, usecases, leading the design and execution of performance, load, and scalability tests. Leadership and Communication: Excellent leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to guide a team and articulate complex technical issues to diverse audiences. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent with practical experience. Software Development Skills: Strong development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Python) and the ability to read and review Android and backend cloud application code. EMM Experience: Knowledge of Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM/MDM) solutions and experience testing application behavior within managed environments. CI/CD Integration: Experience leading the integration of automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) to enable continuous testing. Security Testing: Familiarity with security scanning tools and a solid understanding of common application vulnerabilities. Performance Engineering: Knowledge of advanced tools and techniques for cloud and application performance profiling and optimization.

Develops and executes experiments and performance tests to assess reliability of Zebra's devices/solutions. Learns standard testing methods appropriate for use at various stages of the design and development process. Build familiarity and understanding of assigned products and product cost drivers Learns and develops proficiency with standard engineering tools Perform testing following established test plans and procedures. Completes and reports results of tests per project timelines. Perform basic data analysis Works closely with design engineers and development teams to identify critical performance parameters Develops the ability to recommend actions for maintaining test progress Provides expertise in structured test design, test set-up, metrology, data collection, data interpretation, and statistical analysis to design/project team May present test results to project team, in department management or small groups of other stakeholders Manage bug life cycle using Jira Experience testing Android services is a plus Experience with Robot Framework Automation on Android Devices, Web Automation and API Test using Python Software Testing with Mind map , Test Case design in Jira - SynapseRT Test Management Bachelor's degree 0-2 years experience Proficient with computers and experienced with basic software tools

Analyzes, develops, designs, and maintains software for the organization's products and systems. Performs system integration of software and hardware to maintain throughput and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests: structures and user documentation. Work may be reviewed for accuracy and overall adequacy. Develop and Maintain Features: Write clean, readable, and maintainable code for new and existing features in our enterprise Android applications using Kotlin and Java. Contribute to Technical Solutions: Assist in the implementation of features involving UI, background services, APIs, and inter-application communication under the guidance of senior engineers. Contribute to the Full Development Lifecycle: Participate in all phases of development, from feature design discussions and implementation to writing unit tests, end to end testing and assisting with deployment. Work with Backend Systems: Integrate with backend services by consuming RESTful APIs and ensuring reliable data exchange. Assist in Optimizing Performance: Help identify and fix bugs, and assist in profiling and improving application performance, memory usage, and battery life. Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in native Android application development. Core Skills: Solid programming skills in Kotlin and/or Java, with a good understanding of the Android SDK and fundamental Android Jetpack components. Architectural Expertise: Familiarity with modern architectural patterns such as MVVM or MVI. Android Components: Knowledge of the Android application lifecycle, services, and common components for building user interfaces and handling data. API & Security: Experience consuming RESTful APIs and an understanding of basic secure coding practices. Testing: Experience writing unit tests using frameworks like JUnit and Mockito. Problem-Solving: Good troubleshooting, analytical, and logical skills, with a strong desire to learn and collaborate. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent with practical experience. Full-Stack Interest: An interest in or some experience with backend API development or database management. Peripheral Integration: Familiarity with NFC, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), or other device communication technologies.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify and qualify new business opportunities within the hospitality and large retail sectors. Collaborate with senior sales managers to help develop and execute strategic plans for account growth. Actively support the sales cycle by assisting with the preparation of proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations. Provide operational support for strategic accounts by coordinating with internal sales, marketing, and technical teams on customer projects. Help build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders by supporting customers onboarding, workshops, and ongoing communication. Ensure accurate tracking of account activities and sales data within the CRM system. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Sales or Marketing, Technology, or a related field 1-2 years of experience in business development, sales support, account management, or retail/hospitality technology. Internship experience in the technology or retail sectors is a plus. Fluency in German and business-level proficiency in English are essential. Knowledge of retail technology, POS systems, or mobile computing solutions, familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and experience working with large enterprise accounts is an advantage Strong communication and presentation skills Interest in enterprise technology solutions

Collect and review all payroll-related data, such as timesheets, new hire information and employee changes for your designated payroll. Ensure the data is processed accurately and in timely manner, cooperate with external and internal parties to meet agreed deadlines. Act as an owner of your assigned duties, communicate issues or escalate in timely manner to the senior team members or direct supervisor Backup other Payroll team members when required Maintain strict confidentiality of all records High school diploma is advantage Requires less than 1 year of experience Must be highly organized, detail minded, and able to analyze complex payroll transactions Ability to communicate effectively both oral and written with a customer service approach Ability to work within a team environment and possess skills to support process change Competency in spreadsheet and word processing applications
